categories.main_business_segments: Owens Corning operates through three primary business segments: Composites, Insulation, and Roofing. The Composites segment manufactures glass fiber reinforcements and related products for use in a wide range of applications. The Insulation segment produces thermal and acoustical insulation products for residential, commercial, and industrial markets. The Roofing segment manufactures asphalt roofing shingles and related roofing components.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company’s core technologies center on fiberglass composites, glass fiber manufacturing, and advanced material science. Production methods include vertically integrated processes for glass fiber reinforcement, continuous manufacturing of insulation products, and in-house asphalt processing for roofing shingles. Owens Corning leverages proprietary technologies, extensive R&D, and a robust intellectual property portfolio to drive innovation and efficiency.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Owens Corning serves a diverse customer base including parts molders, fabricators, insulation installers, home centers, lumberyards, retailers, distributors, and contractors. Key end markets are residential and commercial construction, industrial applications, renewable energy (notably wind turbine blades), and infrastructure. The company’s products are used in new construction, repair and remodeling, and various industrial sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: Owens Corning is a global company with operations in 31 countries and manufacturing facilities across North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific, and Latin America. The United States is its largest market, but it also has significant sales and production presence in Europe, China, India, Brazil, Canada, and other regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily as a materials manufacturer, occupying an upstream and midstream position in the supply chain. It produces raw and semi-finished materials (such as glass fiber, insulation, and asphalt shingles) that are supplied to downstream manufacturers, distributors, and end users in the construction and industrial sectors.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Owens Corning’s strategic focus emphasizes material innovation, sustainability, and expanding into higher-growth markets. R&D initiatives target energy efficiency, reduced environmental impact, increased recycled content, and new product development for evolving building codes and customer needs. The company is committed to its 2030 Sustainability Goals, including significant reductions in energy use, emissions, and waste.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through the sale of manufactured products, including composites, insulation materials, and roofing products. Revenue is recognized at the point of transfer of control to customers, with additional income from extended warranties and, to a lesser extent, licensing and joint ventures.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Owens Corning is a global leader in glass fiber reinforcements and North America’s largest producer of insulation. It is the second largest producer of asphalt roofing shingles in the U.S. Major competitors include other global glass fiber manufacturers, fiberglass insulation producers, and U.S. asphalt shingle manufacturers. The company competes on innovation, quality, service, and geographic reach.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2022, Owens Corning reported net sales of $9.8 billion and net earnings of $1.24 billion, with approximately 19,000 employees worldwide. The company has demonstrated strong growth in recent years, driven by higher selling prices and strategic acquisitions, and maintains a robust balance sheet with significant liquidity and investment in capital expenditures.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Owens Corning differentiates itself through material innovation, product quality, and a strong commitment to sustainability. Its products offer energy efficiency, durability, and performance advantages, supported by well-recognized brands and proprietary technologies. The company emphasizes its ability to deliver integrated solutions that meet evolving customer and regulatory demands, while advancing environmental stewardship.
